'''Triton''' was a small, almost lifeless [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the three [[Triton Moons]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moons]] were nefariously used by many in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to describe a dead thing&mdash;as dead as a Triton moon, due to the ban of stimulants of any kind.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Description==
[[File:Planet08-SWR.png|thumb|left|200px|Another view of Triton.]]
Triton was an unremarkable planet besides its location at the intersection of several [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes. It was covered by a hardpan desert expanse baked by sunlight which was reflected yellow.

The planet's moons were no more than checkpoints along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] on its way to the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] and the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

==Society==
The [[Tritonite]]s of this world developed a faith around the writings and teachings of the mysterious [[Gactimus]]. Travelers to the moons or the planet were required to tithe away money or possessions to Gactimus, and some spacers were forced to join the mysterious cult.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Triton was the site of a [[Battle of Triton|battle]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] besieged [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] holdings on the planet, or possibly its moons.

==Behind the scenes==
Triton is also the name of a [[Wikipedia:Triton (moon)|real moon]] orbiting [[Wikipedia:Neptune|Neptune]] in the [[Wikipedia:solar system|solar system]].

While the moons are often used as an idiom for something dead and lifeless, one of the moons is home to the [[Tritonite]] species.
